text:
pm-ryan: quick postmortem follow-up — consolidating owners & cadence for streaming/chat reconnect + partial-response remediation. i want a single bridge team to own end-to-end until we hit stable for 2 weeks. TL;DR: ownership, short-term mitigations, infra alerts, and a test harness for reconnect/backoff logic.

Sanjay: I can co-own the runbook and the reconnect client changes. i'll take the ticket for client-side backoff logic.

Maria: i'll own server-side detection for partial responses and add a metric for 'partial_chunk_detected' + a high-priority alert. plan to ship a prometheus rule by EOD Thu.

Elaine: i'll handle SLA routing policies and fallback model variants to reduce timeouts during bursts. will coordinate with infra for capacity reservations.

Ken: ops-bot wrote an incident playbook earlier but it's scattered. i'll consolidate steps and the quick rollback plan into a single doc, link it to the postmortem, and own the canary for the reconnect lib.

pm-ryan: concrete next steps:
- SANJAY: RED-7421 client reconnect backoff implementation + unit tests — ETA Tue (48h)
- MARIA: RED-7422 partial-chunk metric + alert rule — ETA Thu EOD
- ELAINE: RED-7423 routing fallback + capacity pin — ETA Fri
- KEN: RED-7424 consolidated runbook + canary plan — ETA Mon next week

Sanjay: adding implementation notes — prefer exponential backoff with jitter. quick patch: 200ms -> 500ms -> 1s -> 2s cap. example config: ```backoff_ms = [200, 500, 1000, 2000] jitter = true```

Maria: alert thresholds suggestion: when partial_chunk_detected > 5/min over 1m for production chat endpoints, page P0. For dev/staging page P3.

Elaine: note about routing fallback — we should prefer a smaller context model variant (quantized) in the same region to avoid cross-region latency. fallthrough: retry the request on the fallback model with preserved conversation state.

Ken: runbook outline I'm adding: detection -> immediate retry policy (do not double-charge client) -> short-circuit fallback to model variant -> ticket creation template -> handoff to oncall. will add exact commands.

pm-ryan: can we add an automated test harness to simulate long-tail partial chunks and client disconnects? i want it in CI gating the reconnect lib.

Sanjay: yes, i'll write a small harness that spins up a fake streaming endpoint that drops final chunk 1/30 requests and forces mid-stream resets. will add a Jenkins job and a GH action. ticket RED-7425.

Ken: ops-bot, can you create a recurring 2-week check-in for the bridge team and post the calendar invite?

ops-bot: recurring event created: "Streaming Reliability Bridge — cadence: Mon/Wed 30m" starting 2026-03-30. Invite sent to participants. :white_check_mark:

Maria: quick question — should alerts auto-create a ticket? i'd prefer alerts to open a prefilled ticket with headers and the conversation id to speed triage.

Ken: yes, do that. i'll add a template.

pm-ryan: docs & observability tasks:
- add token-level trace for streaming sessions touching reconnects (Maria + Ken)
- surface per-route reconnect rate in console (Elaine + infra)
- add regression tests comparing token counts before/after reconnect (Sanjay)

Sanjay: pushing a draft PR in ~4h for the backoff lib. will include tests that assert no double-charges and correct KV cache resumption.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: staging reconnect-lib v0.9.1 by Sanjay. CI green, scheduled 2026-03-25 22:00 UTC.

Maria: putting dashboards on my plate — will add a heatmap for partial chunks by region + instance.

Elaine: will follow up with capacity numbers required for fallback models so finance/sales are aware of potential cost changes.

pm-ryan: follow-ups:
1) owners should update RED-7421..7425 with short acceptance criteria and a test plan by EOD today.
2) Ken to publish consolidated runbook and link in the postmortem doc.
3) ops-bot scheduled recurring sync + calendar invites.
4) we reconvene next Tue for a rollup of progress.

Sanjay: ack. I'll update the tickets and post links here. :thumbsup:

Maria: ack. ping me if you want dashboard pair programming.

Elaine: ack. I'll coordinate capacity with infra today.

Ken: ack — merging runbook draft to docs/incident-runbooks shortly.

pm-ryan: thanks all. this bridge team owns streaming reconnect stability until we have 14 days without regression. closing the loop: if any new partial-chunk spikes appear, escalate to P0 and activate runbook.

Ken: one more note — logs we need from the client to triage quickly: request_id, session_id, last_chunk_index, kv_cache_resume_token. add to logging plan.

Sanjay: will include client log shim for those fields in the PR.

pm-ryan: great. if no objections i'll mark this thread as the canonical action list and update the postmortem doc with owners/tickets. :rocket:
